approved_tools.name: Shape Detective
approved_tools.purpose: The child taps the parts of India Gate, the Qutub Minar and a street picture, chooses the block shape that models each part, and spots shapes hidden in a picture.

approved_tools.name: Guess the Shape
approved_tools.purpose: The child guesses a shape from three clues, then sorts everyday objects and flat shape cards by their sides, corners and faces, and cuts shapes into smaller shapes.
approved_tools.flow_row: Topic 2: Guess the Shape (Lesson 1, second part)

approved_tools.name: Match the 3D Shape
approved_tools.purpose: The child drags the name of each solid onto its picture: triangular prism, square pyramid, cube, hexagonal prism and triangular pyramid.

approved_tools.name: Build Your Own 3D Shape
approved_tools.purpose: The child drags, turns and arranges blocks to build a triangular prism, a square-based pyramid and a cube from smaller unit cubes, then names the shape they built.

approved_tools.name: Prisms and Pyramids
approved_tools.purpose: The child sorts solids one by one into a Prism basket or a Pyramid basket by looking at their faces, and sees at once whether each one is right.

approved_tools.name: Nets of 3D Shapes
approved_tools.purpose: The child folds the net of a cube into a solid, then the net of a cuboid or a pyramid, building the idea that a net is a solid opened out flat.

approved_tools.name: Which Net Makes Which Shape
approved_tools.purpose: The child matches each net to the solid it folds into: six connected squares to a cube, six rectangles to a cuboid, and a square with four triangles to a square pyramid.

approved_tools.name: Find the Wrong Net
approved_tools.purpose: The child sees three nets for one solid, finds the one net that will not fold into it and says why.

approved_tools.name: Faces Edges and Corners
approved_tools.purpose: The child labels the faces, edges and corners of a cube and taps each part to see it light up.

approved_tools.name: Count and Win
approved_tools.purpose: The child counts the faces, edges and corners of a cube, a cuboid, a triangular prism and a square pyramid, types each count and sees at once whether it is right.

approved_tools.name: Spin the Shape
approved_tools.purpose: The child spins a die and a cuboid, says how many faces show from each side, and finds opposite faces and faces that touch.

approved_tools.name: Cube Towers and Drawings
approved_tools.purpose: The child builds cube towers from a box of small cubes: a tower of three cubes, a tower with two cubes at the bottom and one on top, and a structure of six cubes, and counts the cubes used.

approved_tools.name: Look Carefully
approved_tools.purpose: The child counts all the cubes in a 3D arrangement, including the partly hidden ones, and picks the right answer from four choices.

approved_tools.name: Copy the Cube Structure
approved_tools.purpose: The child recreates a sample cube structure on an empty grid with draggable cubes, compares it with the original, and copies cube structures on dot paper.

approved_tools.name: Angle Builder
approved_tools.purpose: The child moves one arm of an angle to make angles smaller than, equal to and bigger than a right angle, and finds and checks right angles with a paper corner.

approved_tools.name: Angle Sorting
approved_tools.purpose: The child sorts and names angles as acute, right or obtuse by comparing each with a right angle, in angle pictures and in shapes.

approved_tools.name: Beat the Clock
approved_tools.purpose: The child looks at one angle at a time and picks acute, right or obtuse from three answers, and sees at once whether it is right. There is no clock and no points.

approved_tools.name: Circle Detective
approved_tools.purpose: The child makes a circle, labels its centre, radius and diameter, and folds paper to see that the diameter is double the radius.

approved_tools.name: Radius or Diameter
approved_tools.purpose: The child is given the radius or the diameter of a circle, finds the other one by using that the diameter is double the radius, and types the answer in an answer box. Plain numbers, no units.

approved_tools.name: Build a Pentagon
approved_tools.purpose: The child joins five equal sides into a pentagon, counts its sides and corners, pushes it to see its angles change, and compares shapes with three, four and five angles. The pentagon is met inside the tool: there is no picture before it.

approved_tools.name: Triangle vs Rectangle
approved_tools.purpose: The child pushes a corner of a triangle frame and of a rectangle frame and sees that the triangle keeps its shape while the rectangle's angles change.

approved_tools.name: Build a Strong Structure
approved_tools.purpose: The child builds square frames, adds a stick across the corners to make triangles, and finds strong frames in matchstick puzzles and spider webs.

approved_tools.name: True or False
approved_tools.purpose: The child reads four statements about rigid shapes one at a time and taps True or False, and sees the reason at once.

approved_tools.name: Shape Identification Quiz
approved_tools.purpose: The child looks at pictures of shapes from the whole chapter, solids, nets, angles, circles, pentagons and rigid frames, and names each one, and sees at once whether it is right.

approved_tools.name: Digital Worksheet
approved_tools.purpose: The child works through a short worksheet of mixed practice on all eight lessons, fill in the blanks, match, count and sort, and sees at once whether each answer is right.

approved_tools.name: Sample Online Assessment
approved_tools.purpose: The child answers a sample assessment of eight questions in three sections, fill in the blanks, short answers and solve, with each answer checked at the end. No clock, no marks, no degrees, no cm.
